rule: For each GMI claim, instantiate the strongest matched parent at the same scope before retaining any GMI residual.

terminal_rules: Architecture or paradigm names are never a GMI residual.
A new domain/species requires bounded reduction failure plus material lifecycle separation.
Parent coverage is continuously revisable and never licenses ALL_RELEVANT_PARENTS_KNOWN.
